title: knowledge
description: Draft. A knowledge bundle: a folder tree in the Open Knowledge Format v0.2, published byte for byte. Every Markdown file except index.md and log.md is a concept whose YAML front matter carries a non-empty type; other files, such as JSON or SQL, ride with the bundle as written. The bundle has no entry file, so spec names it and nothing more.
